experiment_recipes.goal: Establish that image input materially improves performance over text-only and random on a standard multiple-choice benchmark
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: On MMBench zero-shot with a fixed shared instruction and decoding, Qwen-VL (vision-enabled) must exceed its own vision-disabled/text-only accuracy by at least 10.0 percentage points and exceed the random-guess baseline by at least 15.0 percentage points; the 95% bootstrap CI (>=10,000 resamples) for the vision-enabled minus vision-disabled difference must exclude 0.0. Failure of any condition refutes.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Confirms that subsequent image-understanding evaluations are not driven by language priors or chance, a prerequisite norm before any headline claims.

experiment_recipes.goal: Validate a robust multiple-choice answer extractor (LLM-backed) so scoring is not a parsing artifact
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Two-part: (a) Under a forced-choice prompt that requires outputting only a single letter, LLM-backed extraction (Gemini) must agree with strict regex extraction on >=99.0% of items (N>=200 sample); (b) Under a free-form prompt, the absolute difference in benchmark accuracy when scoring with LLM-backed extraction vs heuristic-only must be <=0.5 percentage points. Violation of either part invalidates the apparatus.
depends_on: Establish that image input materially improves performance over text-only and random on a standard multiple-choice benchmark
experiment_recipes.rationale: Reliable choice parsing is a standard apparatus to prevent instruction/formatting idiosyncrasies from corrupting accuracy estimates.

experiment_recipes.goal: Produce stability-aware accuracy via CircularEval and template shuffles; ensure low prompt/position sensitivity
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: With 4 distinct instruction templates and 4 circular shifts of answer order: (i) the max-min accuracy range across templates must be <=2.0 percentage points; (ii) circular consistency rate (fraction of items remaining correct across all 4 answer-order shifts under a fixed template) must be >=90.0%; (iii) mean per-item choice-distribution entropy across shifts must be <=0.8 bits. Any failure refutes stability claims.
depends_on: Validate a robust multiple-choice answer extractor (LLM-backed) so scoring is not a parsing artifact
experiment_recipes.rationale: Instability-aware prompting and CircularEval are standard norms to control prompt and positional biases; passing thresholds indicate robust, not brittle, results.

experiment_recipes.goal: Attribute discrepancies to formatting vs underlying preferences by comparing generation-based scoring to likelihood-based scoring
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: On the same MMBench items and prompts, the absolute difference between accuracy from option-likelihood argmax and from generation-plus-extraction must be <=3.0 percentage points. Exceeding this bound indicates instruction/formatting confounds and refutes that the measured effect reflects underlying model preferences.
depends_on: Validate a robust multiple-choice answer extractor (LLM-backed) so scoring is not a parsing artifact
experiment_recipes.rationale: This control is a standard ablation to ensure errors are not artifacts of decoding or output formatting.

experiment_recipes.goal: Quantify statistical stability with bootstrap CIs; ensure sufficient sample size per norm
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Using >=10,000 bootstrap resamples over >=1,000 evaluated items, the 95% CI full width for accuracy must be <=5.0 percentage points. Wider CIs fail the norm by indicating insufficient statistical stability.
depends_on: Produce stability-aware accuracy via CircularEval and template shuffles; ensure low prompt/position sensitivity
experiment_recipes.rationale: Reporting tight bootstrap CIs is a standard practice to demonstrate estimate reliability and adequate sample size.
